Case Scenario-Il :
ABC & Co is a reputed firm of Chartered Accountants. During the year, the firm was
appointed as the statutory auditor of S Food Limited.
CA Amit, the engagement partner, commenced the audit by obtaining an
understanding of the entity's internal control system. Based on his evaluation, he
concluded that the relevant internal controls were operating efficiently. Accordingly,
he assessed the control risk at a lower level and designed the nature, timing, and
extent of further audit procedures.
While performing audit procedures, CA Amit and his team identified several
misstatements. Management agreed to correct some of them; whereas others remained
uncorrected at the conclusion of the audit.
CA Amit also discussed with the audit team the objectives of audit documentation as
prescribed under SA 230 and use of management assertions in an audit.
During the course of the audit, the management of the company also informed the
auditors that the company proposed to establish a new manufacturing facility and had
approached a financial institution for long-term finance. Since the financial institution
required prospective financial statements for loan appraisal, the management
requested ABC & Co. to examine the financial forecasts and issue an appropriate
report.
Simultaneously, CA Bhim a partner of ABC & Co., was leading the audit of
J Co-operative Society. The audit included verification of receivables including
overdues and disclosure requirements on the receivable balances of the society.
YCD(H)
